news.title: News & Updates
news.subtitle: Stay informed about our latest activities and the impact we're making together.

items.title: Empowering Young Mothers: New Vocational Training Cycle Begins
items.summary: GNE launches its 5th vocational training cycle in Kigali, supporting 50 young mothers with tailoring and business skills to achieve financial independence.

items.title: Back-to-School Drive Success: 200 Children Supported
items.summary: Thanks to our generous donors, we've successfully provided school supplies and tuition support for 200 children in rural districts for the upcoming term.

items.title: GNE Youth Innovation Hub: Bridging the Digital Divide
items.summary: Our new hub in Musanze is now open, providing internet access, digital literacy workshops, and mentorship for aspiring young entrepreneurs.

events.title: Upcoming Events
events.subtitle: Join us and be part of the change. Participate in our upcoming community events and workshops.

items.name: Annual Peace & Reconciliation Youth Summit
items.description: Bringing together 500 youth to discuss peacebuilding, community leadership, and social cohesion in a post-conflict society.

items.name: Community Walk for Education
items.description: A 5km community walk to raise awareness and funds for our rural education initiatives and school feeding programs.

items.name: Entrepreneurship Mentorship Day
items.description: An interactive session where established Rwandan business leaders share their journeys and mentor youth from our entrepreneurship programs.

donate.title: Invest in a Brighter Future
donate.subtitle: Your contribution directly empowers vulnerable children and youth in Rwanda to become self-reliant citizens.
donate.trustDescription: 90% of every donation goes directly to our community programs. We are committed to transparency and measurable impact.
